notes: Voice notes now transcribe even on machines without MLX Core: the bot uses the model providers you already configured (OpenAI, Groq, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint with a whisper model). Anthropic is skipped automatically. Free-tier users never consume the owner's paid keys.
notes_zh: 没有 MLX Core 的电脑现在也能转写语音消息了：bot 会使用你已配置的模型服务商（OpenAI、Groq 或任何带 whisper 模型的 OpenAI 兼容端点）。Anthropic 会被自动跳过。免费用户不会消耗拥有者的付费密钥。
